articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Community West Bancshares (NASDAQ: CWBC, or the ”Company”), the parent company of Community West Bank announced today the successful completion of the previously announced merger, in which United Security Bancshares (NASDAQ: UBFO), the parent company of United Security Bank, merged with and into Community West Bancshares, with Community West Bancshares as the surviving company, and United Security Bank merged with and into Community West Bank, with Community West Bank as the surviving bank, in an all-stock transaction. Shareholders of both companies approved the merger at special meetings held on March 30, 2026. The merger follows the receipt of all required regulatory approvals and satisfaction of customary closing conditions. Pursuant to the terms of the merger agreement, United Security Bancshares shareholders received 0.4520 shares of Community West Bancshares common stock for each share of United Security Bancshares common stock. articles.title: Community West Bancshares Completes Merger With United Security Bancshares, Creating a Stronger Community Bank in Central California
